command_line:
set -eu
{
  echo '--- /software/atac-seq-pipeline ---'
  ls -la /software/atac-seq-pipeline
  echo '--- src ---'
  ls -la /software/atac-seq-pipeline/src
  echo '--- top scripts ---'
  find /software/atac-seq-pipeline -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,300p'
  echo '--- python3 ---'
  which python3 || true
  python3 --version 2>&1 || true
  echo '--- java ---'
  which java || true
  java -version 2>&1 || true
  echo '--- singularity ---'
  which singularity || true
  echo '--- docker ---'
  which docker || true
  echo '--- womtool / cromwell ---'
  which cromwell || true
  find /software -maxdepth 3 -iname '*cromwell*' -o -iname '*caper*' 2>/dev/null | head -100
  echo '--- env ---'
  env | sort | grep -E 'ATAC|PIPELINE|ENCODE|CROMWELL|JAVA|PYTHON|CONDA' || true
} > ls.txt
